name: Multiresolution MIP based on adjunction pyramid
definition: A multiresolution MIP algorithm for adjunction pyramids where details are non-negative. It allows direct refinement in the image plane without 3-D volume reconstruction, leveraging the commutativity of MIP and dilation.
summary: Multiresolution MIP based on adjunction pyramid performs progressive volume rendering by refining images in 2D, avoiding 3D reconstruction by exploiting non-negative detail signals.
